scope: Official defensive education and conceptual models; separate from qualifying award reports

skillset_definitions.title: Model access-control invariants
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Document expected actor, action, resource, and tenant relationships in an authorized design review

skillset_definitions.title: Review identity lifecycle
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess binding, verification, recovery, linking, and revocation requirements using approved test accounts

skillset_definitions.title: Review approval-state integrity
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Check that approval records bind to immutable content and survive state changes safely

skillset_definitions.title: Reason about concurrent state
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Model ordering assumptions and prove security invariants with local state-machine or unit tests

skillset_definitions.title: Review cloud IAM boundaries
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Compare intended service authority with documented effective permissions and least-privilege requirements

skillset_definitions.title: Threat-model integrations
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Trace documented trust assumptions between services and identify where authorization responsibility changes

skillset_definitions.title: Model build and release trust
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Map trusted and untrusted inputs, artifacts, jobs, and identity boundaries in approved architecture diagrams

skillset_definitions.title: Review artifact isolation
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess separation of caches and artifacts by trust level, and define integrity controls

skillset_definitions.title: Review dependency provenance
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Check explicit registries, namespace ownership, lockfiles, source pinning, and package-origin policy

skillset_definitions.title: Review machine identities
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Document bot and service identity privileges, rotation, approvals, and separation of duties

skillset_definitions.title: Review secrets containment
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess whether secrets are limited to the minimum necessary trusted execution contexts

skillset_definitions.title: Review input trust boundaries
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess validation and data/code separation without collecting offensive payloads

skillset_definitions.title: Review AI authority boundaries
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess least privilege and independent validation at tool execution and data disclosure boundaries

skillset_definitions.title: Review parsing and serialization
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Reason about parser consistency, validation, and safe serialization contracts

skillset_definitions.title: Review client isolation
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Study process, origin, memory-safety, and permission boundaries in patched historical cases

skillset_definitions.title: Write bounded security evidence
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Separate demonstrated impact, modeled impact, remediation, and source uncertainty in review findings

skillset_definitions.title: Review text-encoding invariants
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Identify and document validation contracts at extension and parser boundaries, then verify them with safe unit tests

skillset_definitions.title: Review memory-safety assumptions
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Assess length, bounds, allocation, and lifetime assumptions in owned source code and vendor patches

skillset_definitions.title: Verify remediation evidence
skillset_definitions.defensive_objective: Compare vendor advisories, affected versions, fixes, and regression coverage without reproducing an exploit

diagrams.title: Retrieved content is data, not authority
diagrams.alt_text: User intent and untrusted connector content enter the AI workflow separately. A proposed action reaches an independent policy decision. Only an authorized state change proceeds; otherwise state remains unchanged.

diagrams.title: Approval stays attached to the reviewed version
diagrams.alt_text: Reviewed content and its immutable version are bound to an approval. Execution independently checks that the version still matches. Matching requests proceed with least privilege; mismatches require a new review.
